patterns.rule: Headings use a serif display face distinct from the body's sans-serif face, so a heading is visually a different kind of text, not just a bigger weight of the same font.
Every color token is an HSL triplet stored as a bare CSS custom property and consumed through hsl(var(--name)) — never a hex literal in a component.
The background is an off-white warm neutral, never pure #fff, so large areas of empty space read as considered rather than a blank default.
Interactive controls (button, input, select, checkbox) always render with a visible border or fill and a border-radius from the radius scale — never the unstyled browser default control.
Exactly one accent hue is used for links, focus rings and primary actions; every other color stays neutral so the accent is never competing with itself.
